commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Seven-mana UBR Lord Xander: ETB discards floor(hand/2), declared attack mills floor(library/2), dies sacrifices floor(nonland/2). Build now prioritizes Hellkite/Persist command-zone cheats, Goryo/Necromancy actual graveyard reanimation, Samut/Boots haste and owner-safe targeting, Irenicus persistent nonlegendary Xander, Syr Konrad damage on creature milling, and Bloodchief-Mindcrank on-theme close. Myriad tokens enter attacking without attack triggers, and odd Bruvac half mills leave one card.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Bracket 4 — Optimized, 16 Scryfall Game Changers in the exact revised physical 100. Combo finishes Mindcrank with Duskmantle/Bloodchief (Bloodchief requires three counters), Assault plus Sword combat-damage paid repeats, and commander trigger compression. No generic Breach/LED/Brain Freeze independent turbo requirement.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Nine substitutions prioritize actual Xander zone access, command-zone haste, targetable clone/protection effects and mill/discard payoffs over an independent three-card Grixis Breach turbo engine. Retain premium tutors, interaction and colored mana consistency as necessary to deploy a seven-mana commander. Rejected top-end copy enchantments and more generic cEDH consultation shells do not replace the unique trigger plan.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: Whole original 99 evaluated: 33 front lands, 2 each basic, premium fast mana and talismans, wheel plus Notion/Opposition/Bowmasters, five cheap target/recursion effects, all clone engines, Xander-mill payoffs, three separate backup combos, 8+ interaction cards. Nine selected cuts remove an unneeded independent Breach/LED/Brain Freeze trio, two generic draw-punish creatures, two redundant/conditional free counters, additive kicked Cacophony, and shroud equipment. Retained historic owner-add Hall of Echoes and owner-keep Persist, with new Hellkite/Courser paid interaction.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Exact 100, 97 names; 33 conventional land front faces (2x Island/2x Swamp/2x Mountain) and one new Malakir Mire MDFC as a tapped black option, which increases conditional functional sources to 34 without removing Bojuka Bog. Core U/B/R fetch-dual-triome coverage unchanged; primary new double-red Hellkite and double-black Syr are paid 6/5 mana curve liabilities, offset by one/two-mana Bloodchief/Goryo/Samut/Malakir and seven-mana commander cheat lines. Lost LED burst is explicitly acknowledged, not hidden.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Retain Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Mana Drain, Swan Song, An Offer You Cannot Refuse, Deflecting Swat, Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Deadly Rollick and Toxic Deluge. Cut Force of Negation (free only opponent turn) and Pact (upkeep 3UU risk) for Malakir death-return and Samut immediate haste. Swiftfoot hexproof rather than Greaves shroud permits owner targeting; graveyard hate still beats Necromancy/Goryo/Persist, so Bojuka Bog is preserved to fight opponents being milled.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Nine real one-for-one upgrades shift resources from LED/Breach/Brain Freeze independent storm, generic draw punishment and expensive-upkeep/opponent-turn counters into Xander haste, command-zone cheat via nonlegendary Courser and retained Persist, flash/instant grave recursion, hexproof allowing own targeting, MDFC death-return and two commander-mill finishers. Losses: faster independent combo, early Bowmasters interaction, Notion/Wheel lock, Pact emergency permission, and original shroud zero-equip. The final 33 lands plus Malakir option preserve colors and Bojuka hate.

low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: Fresh off-ranking Samut from October 2026, Hellkite/Persist targeted entry, Bloodchief quest/Mindcrank, Malakir MDFC, and Irenicus permanent nonlegendary clone were compared against EDHREC inclusion and actual High-Synergy labels; no obligation to add every popular card.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Add Waste Not for early discard conversion and Wheel mana/draw while increasing commander-specific payoff density beyond nine swaps. Rejected after full physical 100 because Removing Riverchurn Monument loses the compact two-mana artifact whose once-per-game exhaust converts a prior Xander half-library attack into depletion; Waste Not needs discard when hands often run low.

Use extra discard and Rite of Replication clone bursts as a coherent heavier upper-game package, optimizing burst rather than immediate combat readiness. Rejected after full physical 100 because Removing Karlach on top of Riverchurn loses a second declared Xander attack and the reliable mill-finish exhaust; kicked Rite costs nine mana on top of commander seven, and four-mana mode needs an existing Xander.

Also deploy Echoing Assault to make a temporary Xander ETB/legend-death on repeated attacks, pushing trigger density even higher. Rejected after full physical 100 because Cutting Swan Song additionally removes cheap protection from an already reduced counter suite, while the five-mana Echoing Assault waits until Xander survives to declare an attack. Worse low-turn protection and more high-end congestion.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Older PR #678 proposed Necromancy over Persist as owner-keep cut and Malakir over Bojuka as grave-hate loss. This revision adds Hellkite so Persist is now a real commander-access reanimation target; Necromancy instead displaces Underworld Breach. Malakir is paid by Force of Negation while keeping Bojuka. Boots replaces Greaves by supported own-targeting analysis; 10/11/12 higher-count alternatives preserve decisions.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: Breach/LED/Brain Freeze can win with a deterministic commander-independent line using cheap spells and extra protection; removing it plus Pact and Force of Negation reduces fast goldfish and stack interaction. It could be strongest in hostile combo pods, but it makes the seven-mana Xander a side show and does not capitalize on his printed attack/dies triggers.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: At Bracket 4 optimized but commander-first, the nine replacements develop real Xander zone access, haste, persistent clones and mill-to-life conversion with retained Mindcrank, while retaining five-plus key counters and Altar/Sword combat engines. No randomized multiplayer win rate or total mathematical optimum claimed.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After nine swaps, re-challenged all 33 land slots and the retained Hall of Echoes owner copy, Bojuka Bog against graveyard exploitation, Persist targetable Courser versus Necromancy and Kaya, Karlach and Sword/Assault paid extra combats, Riverchurn Monument late library finishing, Rhystic/One Ring dependable draw, and 5+ remaining stack/protection answers. Three full 100 alternatives with ten, eleven and twelve substitutions were actually composed and SHA-bound; they suffer rising copy top end and loss of direct Xander mill finishing or cheap interaction.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: A two-mana mill-repeat and one-shot graveyard-sized exhaust can finish Xander-targeted libraries even with empty opponent hands. Waste Not benefits early discard but its trigger floor declines after the first Xander ETB and offers no mill completion.

Karlach grants a second actual declared Xander attack when its combat trigger resolves. Rite is flexible one-copy at four mana but costly kicked at nine, and legend-copy death does not create a new attack trigger.

The owner-added Hall becomes a second potential declared Xander attacker after five-mana activation; Tower is an efficient sacrificial black source but Altar of Dementia already covers command-zone death routing.

Persist recurs nonlegendary Hellkite Courser after Entomb to put Xander directly from command zone with haste. Kaya protects actual Xander already in play but is enchantment vulnerable and has no MDFC land side.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Nine reflects the better whole-100 card mix, not the five-swap minimum or any upper limit. The strongest tenth (Waste Not over Riverchurn) loses an executable half-library follow-up once opponents have few discardable cards; the eleventh (Rite over Karlach) loses a native extra declared Xander attack and adds nine-mana kicker, and the twelfth (Echoing over Swan) erodes necessary early counter protection for a five-mana engine that needs Xander already attacking. Other candidate-specific tradeoffs are listed. Stop because remaining substitutions exchange unique commander engine, color access, or interaction reliability for redundant/delayed trigger density.
